understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate through each level and activate every goal cell by arriving on it while the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly match the goal's requirements. Completing all goals advances through the levels, and winning all levels completes the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement uses directional actions and walls can block movement while still consuming stamina. Shape modifiers cycle the piece's shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate it 90 degrees clockwise. The piece must be adjusted using these tiles before stepping onto a goal. Stamina decreases with actions; when it reaches zero, a life is lost and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game. In this episode, the piece had the correct other attributes but remained at 270° instead of the required 0°, requiring travel to the rotation changer at [19,30].
